text:
mina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: we need explicit windows for (1) API streaming canary+GA, (2) Console Optimize recommendations beta, (3) quantization/packing guidance beta. Team needs dates for sprint planning.

olivia (CEO): Short summary: streaming canary ~6 weeks; GA depends on canary results (+~3 weeks if all green). Console Optimize beta ~9 weeks staged. Quantization guidance around quarter end. We'll publish a single timeline doc with owners by Friday.

zane (Product): To be clear: initial betas are invite-only (internal + selected customers). Console will have an opt-in toggle for suggestions.

kai (Eng): Streaming status: finishing perf runs for an attention kernel fix. Gating metric is p50 token latency <120ms at baseline load. If perf holds, canary deploy moves forward.

priya (Optimize Eng): Recommendation backend done; UI + guardrails remain. Plan for telemetry opt-in and a retention policy. Beta suggestions will be non-billing.

deploy-bot: Planned canary deploy: streaming-runtime-canary -> 2027-08-12T09:00Z

mina: Two quick asks: 1) Will rollouts auto-fallback to quantized model variants on SLO breach? 2) Will Optimize suggestions be billed during beta?

zane (Product): 1) Yes, rollout policy includes automatic fallback to compatible quantized or non-streaming variants on sustained SLO breach. 2) Beta suggestions free; monetization TBD after beta.

kai (Eng): Quick deploy hint for canary test:
```bash
RW_FEATURE_STREAM=1 ./deploy --env canary
```

priya (Optimize Eng): We'll add a consent checkbox in Console and document retention/ACLs for telemetry. Need Security & Legal signoff.

olivia (CEO): Thanks. @mina @zane please publish the timeline doc and owners; marketing to prepare a short customer note after dates are final.

ash-marketing: Will draft customer-facing blurb within 48h after timeline publish.

mina: Great, that clarifies sprint planning. I'll coordinate quota changes with infra after the canary date is set. :white_check_mark:
